args.body:
- Newsletter: Saltmarsh Foods' latest edition covers retail returns logistics, pointing to their blog article at blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns.
- Linked article ("Retail returns logistics"): apparel return rates reached 24%, and consolidating return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth.
- Companion piece (insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion): resale within 10 days kept most of the margin.
args.title: Saltmarsh Foods newsletter — Retail returns logistics
